race.comment: BETTER SWEET (12) returned in fine fashion with a strong Ipswich victory and winning rider Lerena sticks in the irons. Has placed over this track and trip and will have come on even further with that run now under the belt. Can go back-to-back to start the campaign. AIR WE GO (3) got the job done at the Sunny Coast last time out and gets a stack of weight relief with the 3kg claim. Include in calculations. KRAKARIB (1) will be ready to peak now third run back from the break and has a bit of class over this field. Top-three candidate. NOT SURPRISED (7) has been plying her trade in harder races in town and will appreciate the drop back in company here. Watch for a spike in form. THE LITTLE PUMPER (8) next best.
